verdict.rationale: Datadog has a dedicated first-party 'OpenTelemetry in Datadog' docs page. Hands-on users confirm that OTel-instrumented apps (Elixir, the OTel agent) send traces Datadog captures, but one user reports OTel traces render poorly in the UI ('io.opentelemetry.something' names), which undercuts 'first-class'. missing for 10: explicit documentation of direct OTLP ingest endpoints or protocols, documented detail of how deep the OpenTelemetry support goes, and evidence that OTel data gets UI treatment equal to Datadog-native traces.

support.subject: As a developer, I can send telemetry directly over OTLP with first-class OpenTelemetry support

citations.quote: Had to use OTel for Elixir apps since there's no DD SDK for Elixir/Erlang.
It captures mostly the same traces
